changelog: PLAY IT FROM THE KEYBOARD. The whole battle is reachable without the mouse. Left and right — or A and D — walk along your hand, 1 to 9 jump straight to a card, down looks at the focused card and up plays it. Tab turns the danger overlays on and off as one thing. Q flips a gun between Aim and Move. F fires your Command Power, E ends the turn, T opens your army, R your deck and G your relics. Escape cancels what you are doing, or closes whatever is open. Plus and minus zoom, 0 returns to the whole board. All of them are listed under How to Play. RIGHT-DRAG PANS, on a mouse or a trackpad — it grabs the ground and carries it with the cursor rather than pushing a scrollbar, and it keeps working if you drag off the board and release over the HUD. YOUR TRACKPAD KEEPS ITS OWN GESTURES: two-finger scroll pans and pinch zooms, unchanged. The wheel-zoom that arrives in this build is for mice, and a trackpad is never mistaken for one — including during a fast flick, where the momentum used to read as a wheel and zoom the battlefield mid-pan; that was found and fixed on a Mac before this shipped. FIXED: a coach tip could end up drawn behind the very panel it was describing after a long session of opening and closing menus. Still universal and still notarized: one download runs natively on Intel and Apple Silicon, and opens with no Gatekeeper warning.
